Interview with John Birks Gillespie
(About John Collins) by Patricia Willard

PRO-TYPISTS, INC.
PROFESSIONAL TRANSCRIPTION SERVICE
AREA CODE 202 347-5395
What do you want me to say about John?

Whatever you want to say about John but last year I believe it was I gave you the name when you were being interviewed and you made a statement about John and what he gave you musically or what you had learned from his musically; an evaluation that was something I'd never heard before. So what I would like to know is that statement and then your evaluation of John.
